title: Address.fromScAddress on the 16.x line refuses a muxed contract address (Protocol 30)
severity_basis: A valid Protocol 30 value decodes but the Address class refuses it; muxed contract addresses came to the 17.x line in 17.3.0 and are not on the 16.x maintenance line.

entries.observed: Executed on 16.4.1: the Protocol 30 XDR decodes the SCAddress, but Address.fromScAddress throws 'Unsupported address type: scAddressTypeMuxedContract'. Muxed contract addresses came to the Address class in 17.3.0 (#1811); the 16.x line does not have them.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L4, on js@16.4.1.
evidence.expected_basis: SC_ADDRESS_TYPE_MUXED_CONTRACT is an SCAddress arm in the Protocol 30 XDR definitions (CAP-84).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0020.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added. The 16.x maintenance line receives critical security fixes only (js-stellar-sdk SECURITY.md); no backport request is drafted unless a maintainer decides to ask for one.

history.note: Created from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/stellar/js-stellar-sdk/pull/1811 and their failure rows.
